common.broken_page: Broken page? Wrong answer? Missing subject?
common.be_specific: Be specific — a URL and what you expected helps us fix it.
common.self_hosted: Self-hosted. No trackers. No third-party scripts.

install.without_downloading: You can use the full website without downloading anything. On Android or iPhone, add this same HTTPS site to your home screen.
install.tap_menu: Tap the menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app.
install.confirm: Confirm. The icon appears on your home screen.
install.offline_limited: Offline access is limited to previously cached public pages; submissions and sign-in need a connection.
install.alternative_apk: An alternative Android wrapper for this same HTTPS website is available as a signed GitHub Release.
install.apk_checksum: Check the release, its SHA-256 checksum and signing certificate before installing.
install.apk_unofficial: Android may ask you to allow installs from this source. Only install the APK from the official release; never from a forwarded copy. Updates require a new signed release.
install.no_apk: No signed APK has been published and configured for this site yet. Do not install an APK from an unofficial source. Use the web app above in the meantime.
install.apk_twa: The APK is a Trusted Web Activity, not an offline copy of the backend.
install.iphone_steps: Open this site in Safari. Tap Share. Choose Add to Home Screen.
install.desktop_text: Use your browser menu or the install icon in the address bar.

auth.sign_in_to_use: Sign in to use {site}: notes, practice, coding and your progress all live behind your account.
auth.first_party_auth: First-party authentication. We never hand your credentials to a third party.
auth.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {masked}. It expires in 5 minutes and works once.
auth.recovery_code: A recovery code works here too. It can be used once.
auth.username_hint: 3-24 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore. This becomes your portfolio URL.
auth.phone: Mobile number with country code (optional, for SMS OTP & recovery)
auth.registration_closed_text: The administrator has turned new sign-ups off. Existing accounts can still sign in.

errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Please slow down.
